reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 Kreston AUP report, published July 15, was recovered through the SharePoint viewer on October 1. It reports AnchorX Global Limited reserves of 39,221,874 CNH as cash held at regulated financial institutions against 39,128,445 AxCNH, while AnchorX.KZ Limited had 56.47 CNH and zero circulating tokens. This dated report does not identify banks or establish current reserve allocation. The unknown reserve envelope and June composition date remain unchanged pending current, identity-matched evidence; the earlier report-access blocker is resolved.

reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The recovered June report identifies historical CNH cash at unnamed regulated financial institutions; no current institution-level allocation is established.
